classRecipes.label: FPV Scout
classRecipes.description: A nimble FPV quad. Scan shows enemy direction hints for four seconds; it never captures territory or slows an enemy.

metadata.title: Orchard Window
metadata.description: Open 65%. Two faster crossing patrols threaten your live line; the contour scout follows the changing reveal boundary. The central mud strip halves flight speed while it is covered. Detour for the speed pickup or choose a clear crossing. Closing a cut stops you: release held controls, then press a fresh direction. Boost with Shift; Pause remains available.
metadata.author: RevealLine
metadata.rightsStatus: Original revised fictional arcade routing layout; same original First Light picture reward, not an additional unique image or reference-game reconstruction.

metadata.title: Split Courtyard
metadata.description: Open 75%. Wall gaps leave broad crossings, but mud slows the direct route. Three fast field patrols share the field with an eroder: its warning marks one threatened secured cell. A rover wakes after its ground is revealed and a visible warning completes; newly opened space can become dangerous. Slow and freeze pickups offer exposed detours. Walls never close a cut. Reconnect, stop, then choose your next fresh direction.
metadata.author: RevealLine
metadata.rightsStatus: Original revised fictional arcade routing layout; same original First Light picture reward, not an additional unique image or reference-game reconstruction.

metadata.title: Night Signal
metadata.description: Open 85%. Horizontal and vertical warning lanes operate on different repeating schedules; watch the visible warnings and keep routing rather than waiting for a scripted opening. Fast field patrols, a contour scout and an awakening secured-ground rover pressure different parts of the board. Mud slows your craft; the marked hot zone is lethal while unrevealed. Optional freeze and life pickups reward a risky detour. A closed cut stops at safe ground; give a fresh direction to continue.
metadata.author: RevealLine
metadata.rightsStatus: Original revised fictional arcade routing layout; same original First Light picture reward, not an additional unique image or reference-game reconstruction.
